summary: iter386 — Verified trial-eligibility gate + reactivation plan-switching + welcome-back wiring. Backend 8/8 tests pass (returning user gets eligible:false and server strips client-sent trial_days:7; fresh signup gets eligible:true and trial retained; _maybe_send_welcome_back is defined once and called in BOTH checkout_status reconcile and the webhook checkout.session.completed branch, with trial-end skip + per-session idempotency; statement-upload 402 regression confirmed for both view-only fixtures). Mobile /plan-select renders all expected testIDs (plan-option-solo/family, plan-choose-solo/family, plan-select-trust, plan-select-cancel) and correctly shows the fresh-trial branch when eligible=true. Web ReadOnlyLock on /app/provider-switch renders two Reactivate CTAs but under the testId prefix `switch-lock-cta-*` (consumer passes custom testId), and this surface's custom `sub` copy OMITS the mandated 'no free trial / immediate paid plan' wording. CRITICAL: clicking Reactivate Solo on the provider-switch surface did NOT trigger a POST to /api/payments/checkout — the Stripe redirect never began.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Reactivate Solo on /app/provider-switch did not fire POST /api/payments/checkout (no network call captured, no Stripe redirect, no toast). Suspect reactivate() handler not being called — verify disabled state, event propagation, and startReactivateCheckout logging.

Review requested data-testid 'read-only-lock-cta-solo'/'read-only-lock-cta-family', but on /app/provider-switch the consumer passes testId="switch-lock" so the rendered ids are switch-lock-cta-solo / switch-lock-cta-family. Component itself is correct — update consumers to use the default or document naming convention.

integration_issues.issue: Reactivate buttons visible but do not initiate Stripe checkout.

issues: Custom `sub` copy on this surface ("The full 5-step guided workflow… turns back on the moment you reactivate.") omits the required 'no free trial / immediate paid plan' messaging the review request mandates. Default ReadOnlyLock copy has it; this consumer overrides it.

parity_issues.issue: Mobile plan-select has clear 'there's no free trial, as you've used Wayly before' copy and 'Reactivate Solo/Family — $price' labels. Web switch-lock surface omits the no-trial wording and uses generic 'Reactivate Solo'/'Reactivate Family' labels without a price.
parity_issues.expected: Both surfaces communicate no-trial + immediate paid reactivation consistently.
parity_issues.actual: Only mobile explicitly states no trial.

action_items: FIX: Make Reactivate Solo/Family buttons on /app/provider-switch (and anywhere else ReadOnlyLock is used with a custom testId) actually call POST /api/payments/checkout. Likely a handler-wiring regression or an unhandled error swallowed by the try/catch in reactivate().

UPDATE: Either pass the default `sub` copy or extend the custom text on provider-switch (and other ReadOnlyLock consumers) so the 'immediate paid plan / no free trial' wording is always present per the roadmap.
DECIDE: Keep per-surface testIds (switch-lock-*, tool-lock-gate-*, etc.) OR normalize to read-only-lock-* to match review spec. Document whichever is chosen.

/app/backend/routes/payments.py: _maybe_send_welcome_back is defined once and called in BOTH checkout_status reconcile (L474) and the webhook checkout.session.completed branch (L992). Guards: skip trials (sub.trial_end), skip non-active/past_due, idempotent via welcome_back_session claim. All correct.

/app/mobile/app/plan-select.tsx: branching on `eligible` is correct; buttonLabel on reactivation includes the price. One minor concern: on apiFetch failure the UI defaults to eligible=true. If the user is actually a returning user and the API is flaky, they would see trial copy — consider showing a loading error instead.

Open items: (1) web Reactivate Solo/Family buttons on /app/provider-switch do NOT trigger /api/payments/checkout — reproduce by logging in as cancelled.vo@example.com, visiting /app/provider-switch, clicking either Reactivate CTA. Expected: redirect to checkout.stripe.com; Actual: no POST /api/payments/checkout request fires. (2) Review-request testIDs 'read-only-lock-cta-solo/family' don't exist here because the consumer passes testId="switch-lock" — buttons are 'switch-lock-cta-solo/family'. (3) The custom `sub` prop on this surface omits the required 'immediate paid / no free trial' wording. Full backend pytest results in /app/test_reports/pytest/iter386.xml.
rca of the issue: Web Reactivate CTA non-functional (HIGH): In ReadOnlyLock.jsx the onClick → reactivate(plan) → startReactivateCheckout(plan) → api.post('/payments/checkout', ...) → window.location.href = data.url. During test, no network request to /api/payments/checkout was observed after clicking the button. Possible root causes to investigate: (a) the surrounding ReactivateLock/switch-lock wrapper intercepts clicks (there is also a tool-lock-gate on the same page that may stop event propagation); (b) startReactivateCheckout throws synchronously and the toast is being suppressed; (c) the button is wrapped by another element capturing the click. Suggested fix: add console.log at entry of reactivate() and inspect devtools, or ensure the inner click isn't delegated to the outer tool-lock-gate 'Reactivate' button.
